expectedIssues: Orders icon is missing from the bottom nav bar
reportedIssues: In the bottom navigation bar, the 'Orders' tab shows only a text label with no icon above it, while 'Home', 'Search' and 'Profile' each have an icon. This leaves an awkward empty gap and makes the tab look broken/inconsistent.

The horizontally scrollable category chip row ends with a chip that is cut off abruptly at the right screen edge with no visual affordance (fade gradient or peeking padding), which can look like a rendering glitch rather than intentional scrollability.
The notification bell button in the top-right uses a very light gray circle on a near-white background, giving low contrast for the control boundary; only the small red dot signals state.
